cryo_board.description: Cryocooler control board via Pico USB-I2C bridge

i2c._comment: Pico GPIO the board's I2C lines are wired to. Confirmed 2026-08-29 by a pull-up sweep on the bench: GP17 and GP16 are the only pins that respond to board power (GP17 shows its pull-up as soon as the board's 3.3V rail comes up); every other GPIO floats. Do NOT use 22/23 - that is the ESP32 default pinout from the original bench script cryo_control_example.py, and GP23 is not even broken out on a Pico.
